title: net1 v6: net1 v5's data plus wider ranges and 120 s episodes, against net1 v5
description: net1 v5 is honest only inside its training ranges (90% coverage 0.91 to 0.97 on test links, not outside them). This trains net1 with net1 v5's settings (experiments/specs/net1v4.json: three members, dropout 0.05, width 512) on net1 v5's data (exp-data-net1-broad-30s-218, -60s-74) plus the wider data of exp-data-net1-v6-221 (one-way delay 5 to 150 ms, buffers 0.25 to 32 BDP, base capacity 1 to 200 Mbit/s, 30 s and 120 s episodes), seeds 0, 1 and 2, and reports it next to net1 v5 (--compare) on the same views: validation and test links of all four sets, net1 v5's four held-out sets (competitors, loss, rtt, buffer) and the two new ones beyond the wide ranges (rtt-wide: 151 to 250 ms; buffer-wide: 32 to 64 BDP). Bins come from the training values' quantiles, so they widen with the data. Choice rule, written before the results: net1 v6 replaces v5 if, on validation rows inside v5's ranges, its log score and 90% coverage are no worse than v5's beyond seed spread, and its coverage on the held-out sets is closer to 0.9. Rows are every 24th step, not every 12th: run 148 loaded every 12th (12.6 million rows) and its runners ran out of memory; every 24th keeps about 6.3 million rows, under net1 v5's 7.2 million, on all the links. Rerun of 11-13: the data is regenerated with the guest that keeps a cross flow inside its planned window (commit 312d15a), and the compare model is the earlier net1 v6 (release model-v6-inputs, trained on data from before that fix), since net1 v5's file is in a format no longer read.
run: uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/net1-v6-s$SEED" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set dropout=0.05 --set width=512 --seed $SEED --stride 24 --data "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "$IN/d60/campaign-train60" "$IN/w/campaign-wide30" "$IN/w/campaign-wide120" --ood competitors="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-competitors" --ood loss="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-loss" --ood rtt="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-rtt" --ood buffer="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-buffer" --ood rtt-wide="$IN/w/campaign-ood-rtt-wide" --ood buffer-wide="$IN/w/campaign-ood-buffer-wide" --compare "$IN/m/net1-v6-s0.pt"
